title: Biased expansion of the selection function
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$ and $x\in\{−1,1\}^3$. For each subset $S\subseteq\{0,1,2\}$, write $M_S^p(x)$ for the biased Fourier product monomial indexed by $S$. The value of the selection function at $x$ is $1-2p$ plus $\frac{1-(1-2p)}{2}\sqrt{4p(1-p)}\,M_{\{1\}}^p(x)+\frac{1+(1-2p)}{2}\sqrt{4p(1-p)}\,M_{\{2\}}^p(x)-\frac{1}{2}\bigl(\sqrt{4p(1-p)}\bigr)^2M_{\{0,1\}}^p(x)+\frac{1}{2}\bigl(\sqrt{4p(1-p)}\bigr)^2M_{\{0,2\}}^p(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: Real parameter p strictly between 0 and 1
caveat: The supplied definitions do not give informal descriptions of the biased product Fourier monomials or the selection function; the notation introduced here names those defined objects, but their full constructions are not stated in the payload.
